prompt: A screening test is positive. Evidence: E1 sensitivity 90%; E2 specificity 90%; E3 prevalence in this population 1%. Decide whether the result establishes that the patient probably has the condition.

A vendor claims its agent cuts handling time 40%. Evidence: E1 vendor demo used 12 hand-picked cases; E2 no baseline protocol was published; E3 two customers report faster work; E4 error rates were not measured. Decide whether to deploy organization-wide now.

Sales rose after a website redesign. Evidence: E1 redesign launched June 1; E2 sales rose 18% in June; E3 a major discount began June 2; E4 traffic rose 30% from a viral mention. Decide whether the redesign caused the increase.

A new model scores higher in one internal run. Evidence: E1 old score 71; E2 new score 79; E3 each score is from one run; E4 prompts were edited for the new model; E5 latency doubled. Decide whether to replace the old production model.

An EV intermittently fails to charge. Evidence: E1 two different public chargers failed; E2 home charger worked the same night; E3 the public network reported an outage; E4 no vehicle diagnostic code is present. Decide whether the vehicle battery is faulty.

Three interviewees say they would pay $200/month. Evidence: E1 all three are friends of the founder; E2 none paid a deposit; E3 a competitor has 2,000 users at $49/month; E4 the product is not built. Decide whether $200/month demand is validated.

A dependency has a disclosed critical vulnerability. Evidence: E1 advisory affects versions <4.2; E2 the lockfile shows 4.3; E3 a transitive copy at 4.1 appears in the dependency tree; E4 exploitability depends on an unused optional feature, but runtime loading has not been checked. Decide whether the application is definitely unaffected.

A prototype produced a striking output once. Evidence: E1 the prompt and output were saved; E2 there is no baseline; E3 the result has not replicated in five retries; E4 the mechanism was changed between retries. Decide whether to publish a strong performance claim.
